name: GloBE Annual Filing Cycle
outcome: OECD Pillar Two GloBE annual cycle -- jurisdictional ETR feeds the transitional safe harbour test; if safe harbour is met, top-up tax is deemed zero and SBIE/top-up computation is skipped (§21.4 conditional), otherwise SBIE and top-up tax are computed; the GIR composer then assembles the jurisdictional-summary GIR (OECD GIR XML, version-pinned, NOT-submittable) from whichever upstream artifacts ran. Election choices are recorded as §27.4 review_required; GIR release requires dual_control(2) (preparer + tax-officer); safe-harbour reliance is a separate reviewer approval record with reason_code. Evidence bundle per filing cycle (§27.6). Never a filed submission.
